messages.subject: I spoke to her
messages.body:
She sent me a copy of her verification receipt. She has her own recovery address and documents.

We compared the names. They look identical on screen. She asked if anyone had compared the original forms we filled in.

The delivery record points to index-09. Could you see what the directory kept from those registrations?

messages.subject: We have the records
messages.body:
I sent her the export. She laughed when I put the two names side by side. Then she asked me to send the numbered version too, so nobody could copy the wrong one into the case.

Support had been telling us one account needed to be deleted. We've sent them both verification records. We'd like to keep both accounts.

Thank you.

- Mira
